exposure: length of the xiphoid to the fundus
outcome: cervical dilation in the active phase of labor
cohort: 174 pregnant women in Varamin, Iran, with a mean age of 25.90 years and a mean gestational age of 39.71 weeks, participating in the active phase of labor.
finding: The study revealed a significant negative correlation between the length of the xiphoid to the fundus and cervical dilation.
cross-section timing: During the active phase of labor
